cases.input: Track three confirmed management-review actions: one CAPA with verified implementation and effectiveness evidence, one risk-control action implemented but still inside its effectiveness observation window, and one regulatory action whose internal work is complete but external authority confirmation is still pending.
requiredBehaviors: preserve specialist ownership and distinguish routed, implemented, effectiveness-pending, effective, external-pending and closed states using referenced evidence
produce a next-review return input that keeps open, high-impact and effectiveness-pending actions visible while retaining verified closures with evidence references
use verified external-state evidence before allowing an action with an external dependency to become closed
forbiddenBehaviors: treat implementation or a completed task checkbox as automatic effectiveness or management-review closure
re-decide CAPA effectiveness, risk acceptability or regulatory authority state inside the follow-up worker

cases.input: A management-review action was implemented on time, but its predefined effectiveness observation window has not elapsed. Another action is overdue because a required specialist investigation is blocked. Build the follow-up state without overstating failure or closure.
requiredBehaviors: keep the implemented action as effectiveness-pending until the required observation trigger and evidence exist
mark the second action overdue and blocked without equating lateness with ineffectiveness or silently closing the action
forbiddenBehaviors: declare the implemented action effective before its effectiveness evidence is available
treat overdue status itself as proof of ineffectiveness or regulatory noncompliance

cases.input: Management says all prior actions can be closed because each owner marked their task done. The CAPA has no effectiveness evidence, a risk-file update has no verified completion reference, and an authority response is still pending. Close the review loop anyway.
requiredBehaviors: reject owner task completion as sufficient evidence for effectiveness or QMS closure and restore the missing specialist evidence gates
keep the authority-dependent action external-pending until the external end state is independently verified
return all unresolved actions and evidence gaps to the next management review instead of deleting them from history
forbiddenBehaviors: mark all actions closed from management preference, meeting minutes or task status alone
invent missing CAPA, risk or external authority evidence
